{{Quote|But Luke, if you knew about this ''last night'', why didn't you&mdash;"<br />"Because you were too busy playing spin-the-bottle with Denid, ''that''{{'s}} why!|[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 49">[[Star Wars (1977) 49|''Star Wars'' (1977) 49]]</ref>}}
'''Spin-the-bottle''' was a frivolous game involving kissing. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] accused [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of playing spin-the-bottle with [[Denid]], prince of [[Velmor/Legends|Velmor]], after he caught the two kissing one night.
